description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database viewer application incorporating CSS styles and JavaScript for UI rendering and data fetching from API endpoints. It provides UI components for database selection, table browsing, and data display.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by fetching fresh data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with clickable cells for expandable content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell HTML with special handling for objects, nulls, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full or truncated content.
